cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: The function uses mark_safe() on user-provided text after processing it with markdown, which can lead to XSS if the input contains malicious scripts. While there is some URL scheme validation, the overall text is not properly sanitized for HTML/JS content.
This method passes ticket descriptions directly to the vulnerable get_markdown() function without additional sanitization, potentially allowing XSS through ticket descriptions.
This property passes ticket resolutions directly to the vulnerable get_markdown() function without additional sanitization, potentially allowing XSS through ticket resolutions.
This method passes follow-up comments directly to the vulnerable get_markdown() function without additional sanitization, potentially allowing XSS through follow-up comments.
This method passes KB item answers directly to the vulnerable get_markdown() function without additional sanitization, potentially allowing XSS through knowledge base content.
